paper-lantern: Row 6 is smudged, but every column reads coral–gold–coral: each column's single gold paints the band.
festival-kite: Row 3 is smudged; the blue runs of columns 3 to 11 climb from the cross bar and fill it in for you.
festival-drum: Row 6 is smudged: the gold rim runs of the columns above and below reach into it and place each stud.
koi-fish: Row 8 is smudged, but column 4's 5b 2a 2b 2a spans the fish and pins the coral spot sitting in it.
fireworks-burst: Column 7 is smudged: X out the side columns' empty cells and each row's lone gold has only the centre left.
moon-lantern: Column 8 is smudged; row 8's 5c 4b must touch, so the lantern's foot and the moon's tip meet inside it.
festival-candle: Row 8 is smudged: column 7's 5a 7b 1a runs from flame to dish, and the side columns finish the wax.
festival-parasol: Column 10 is smudged, but rows 5 and 6 fill edge to edge, so their gold ribs land in it without its clue.
firefly-jar: Row 7 and column 4 are smudged; their crossing is stamped, and the full-width jar rows paint the rest.
paper-boat: Row 8 is smudged, yet every column's run crosses the hull there, so its full deck comes from the columns.
dragon-kite: Row 5 and column 1 are smudged; their corner is stamped, and row 4's 13a 1b overlaps across the head.
lantern-festival: Row 8 and column 9 cut through the big lantern; its stamped heart and striped rows 6, 7, 9 frame them.
